title: Interval dominated convergence under the Hoelder majorant, with its integral
statement: Let n be a natural number and p, R, Lambda, t real numbers with n < p, R > 0, Lambda > 0 and t > 0. Let a_k : R -> R (k in N) and g : R -> R, and put b(tau) := 2 ((p - n)/(4p)) Lambda R^(-1) (tau/R)^(-n/p). Assume that, for all sufficiently large k and every tau in (0, t], a_k is continuous at tau and |a_k(tau)| <= b(tau). Assume also that a_k(tau) -> g(tau) for every tau in (0, t]. Then integral_0^t a_k -> integral_0^t g as k -> infinity, and |integral_0^t g| <= (Lambda/2)(t/R)^(1 - n/p).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (p R Λ t : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), (n : ℝ) < p → 0 < R → 0 < Λ → 0 < t → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ t → ContinuousAt (a k) τ ∧ |a k τ| ≤ 2 * ((p - n) / (4 * p)) * Λ / R * (τ / R) ^ (-((n : ℝ) / p))) → (∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ t → Tendsto (fun k => a k τ) atTop (𝓝 (g τ))) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ τ in (0)..t, a k τ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ τ in (0)..t, g τ)) ∧ |∫ τ in (0)..t, g τ| ≤ Λ / 2 * (t / R) ^ (1 - (n : ℝ) / p)
